name: Blow
why: Kept: moving air that pushes is the monk's push-hands and its running lane.

name: Lull
why: Kept: the still centre; wind's defensive utility (shots drop).

name: Lash
why: Kept: air that cuts, the monk's strike.

name: Buffer
why: Kept: cushioning air is evasion against shots.

name: Lift
why: Kept: launching a foe is a monk's juggle and set-up.

name: Drop
why: Kept, meaning read a little wider: Drop is now also you coming down hard (Downdraft is a leap).

name: Carry
why: Kept: speed, the role's own word.

name: Deflect
meaning: turn a blow or a rush aside, and the one behind it with it
why: Stall ("stalled; slipstream stolen") was wind standing still against a rush, which is an area tank's verb, not an evasive monk's. Deflect keeps its place as Carry's opposite (go with the flow / turn the flow aside), its role (link: it takes the blow in and passes it on, aside) and its draw (+0.6: it takes in what comes at you). Its effect moves from Slowed to the new Turned status: a deflected foe is left facing the wrong way.

name: Whirl
why: Kept: spin together; wind's crowd-gathering utility.

name: Disperse
why: Kept: blow apart, which now leaves them Turned: a positioning verb.
